placeholderNotice: This is a draft. Our legal team will review the final text before launch.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what information Sport Talent collects, why we collect it and the choices you have. The full policy will be published here before launch.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Your phone number, birth month and year, display name, the games you join, check-in results and chat messages. Precise location is used only while the app is open.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To show games near you, to confirm attendance, to keep the community safe and to send you notifications you ask for.

share.title: Who we share it with
share.body: Other players see your display name and reliability. Service providers process data for us under contract. We don’t sell your personal data.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Chat messages are deleted soon after a game ends. Reported messages are kept for a limited time for review. You can delete your account at any time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can access, correct, download or delete your data, and you can object to some uses. Contact us to use these rights.

age.title: Age limit
age.body: Sport Talent is for people aged 16 and older.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms explain how you can use Sport Talent. The full terms will be published here before launch.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You must be 16 or older. Keep your sign-in details safe and give us accurate information.

conduct.title: Fair play and conduct
conduct.body: Treat other players with respect. Show up for games you join, or cancel in good time. Don’t post anything unlawful, hateful or threatening.

games.title: Games and venues
games.body: Games are organized by players, not by Sport Talent. You are responsible for your own safety and for following the rules of each venue.

deposits.title: Deposits
deposits.body: A host may ask for a refundable deposit. It is released after you check in and may be kept if you don’t show up and don’t cancel in time.

sanctions.title: Warnings and restrictions
sanctions.body: We may warn or restrict accounts that break these terms. We explain every decision and you can appeal.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms. We’ll tell you about important changes.

communityRules.title: Community rules
communityRules.intro: Sport Talent works when everyone feels welcome. These rules apply to chats, profiles and games.
communityRules.respect: Be respectful. No harassment, hate or threats.
communityRules.safety: Keep it safe. No violence, and no sharing other people’s personal details.
communityRules.honesty: Be honest. Use your real details, and add only real venues.
communityRules.reliability: Show up, or cancel in good time.
communityRules.content: No spam, adverts or sexual content.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Questions, feedback or a request about your data? Get in touch and we’ll reply as soon as we can.

reportContent.title: Report illegal content
reportContent.body: If you see content that you believe is illegal, tell us what and where, and we’ll review it.
